title: Stochastic Analysis of Cybersecurity Defense Strategies Under Single Attack Scenario
summary: This research presents a novel stochastic framework for proactive cybersecurity defense timing under a single attack scenario. The approach models the defense process as a continuous observation mechanism in which the defense instant and the subsequent observation slot follow independent exponential distributions. Laplace-Carson transforms combined with first-excess theory yield the joint detection function that brackets the attack moment.
